verdict.rationale: Shopify documents agent attribution metadata on carts: referring_domain, click_id, activity_id and UTM fields. Checkouts created from a cart inherit that metadata, and every request is tied to the agent's UCP profile, so orders can carry their originating agent. Order MCP and order webhooks are scoped to 'orders placed through your agent', but that is the agent's view, not a merchant report. Missing for 10: any documented merchant-side reporting, analytics or admin filtering of orders by agent; confirmation that attribution persists on the final merchant order record; independent or hands-on corroboration.
